note: Banco General only, the largest bank, its page read in full; Banistmo's and BAC Panamá's card tariffs weren't reached in this pass. Banco General's rates, fees and charges, in US dollars (the card tables say updated October 2025; the note before this read gave October 2026, which is the date of another table on the page), its fees including the 7% ITBMS tax: its sixteen personal cards (Estrellas, MileagePlus, ConnectMiles, Esencial and CashBack; the Visa Esencial Classic / Gold isn't available and the 4You card has no table), each with the main card's yearly membership (none on the Esencial cards), its nominal annual rate on purchases and on cash advances, a minimum payment of 3% of the month's balance with a floor of 20 dollars on the Classic, Gold and Standard cards and 25 on the others (the table gives two floors across the Estrellas cards' six columns, read as 20 for the entry cards and 25 for the rest), a late payment charge of 53.50 dollars (a maximum on the Esencial and CashBack cards, written as the charge), a charge for exceeding the permitted overdraft of the limit (32.10, 42.80 or 53.50 dollars by card; the 5% or 10% overdraft allowed first isn't modelled, so the charge is written as the over-limit fee), a cash advance charge of 5% with a floor of 7.49 dollars (plus ITBMS, not added) and up to 3% on foreign currency conversion, written as 3%. The rate rises 3.5 points a year after a late payment once the card is a year old, a step that isn't written as a penalty rate. No grace period is stated.
